sources.title: Ornith-1.5: From Self-Scaffolding to Self-Improvement
sources.snippet: Ornith-1.5 extends the self-scaffolding framework introduced in Ornith-1.0 into a more complete self-improvement loop: the model proposes new tasks, generates task-specific scaffolds, and produces solution rollouts for reinforcement learning, continuously creating new learning experiences from which it can improve.

sources.title: Ornith 1.5 35B | Model APIs - runinfra.ai
sources.snippet: Ornith 1.5 35B is an LLM listed in RunInfra Model APIs. RunInfra serves it as ornith-ai/Ornith-1.5-35B-A3B at $0.10 per 1M input tokens and $0.40 per 1M output tokens. Its context window is 262,144 tokens. The API provides OpenAI-compatible chat completions.

sources.title: Ornith-1.5 — open MIT model matches Claude Opus… | AI/TLDR
sources.snippet: Ornith-1.5 is a family of open-weight models released under MIT in 397B and 35B mixture-of-experts and 9B dense sizes. The 397B scores 86.1 on Terminal-Bench 2.1 against 85.0 for Claude Opus 4.8. An open-weight model family that writes its own training tasks, then trains on them.
